text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Monday, November 5, 2018 Posted by admin on November 5th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include McDonald’s (MCD) and Merck (MRK). Dow stock 52 week lows include IBM (IBM).
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -27 points.
Friday the Dow was down -109.91 (-0.43%) at 25,270.83.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +2.23%.
There were 21 Dow stocks up Friday.
The Dow stock winners Friday were led by CHevron (CVX) +3.20%, Exxon Mobil (XOM) +1.59% and Goldman Sachs (GS) +1.20%.
The Dow stock losers Friday were led by Apple (AAPL) -6.63%, Intel (INTC) -2.30% and Pfizer (PFE) -1.69%.
Chevron (CVX +3.20%) was upgraded to ‘Outperform’ from ‘Neutral’ at Credit Suisse with a price target of $138.
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended lower.
The national average price of gasoline is down four-tenths of a cent at $2.761 per gallon.
